fluff.overview: The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery assigns conventional infantry to garrison roles across its military districts, with district regulars often fielding extra platoons to secure worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently garrison. Wheeled mechanized infantry ride armored personnel carriers that offer speed on roads and enough protection to survive initial contact. The DCMS assigns these platoons where garrison duty demands both rapid response and the ability to dismount under fire, a combination that foot and motorized troops cannot reliably deliver. Armed with infantry-scale gauss rifles that use magnetic acceleration to hurl projectiles at extreme velocities. The longest-ranged and hardest-hitting personal ballistic weapon available to conventional soldiers, though the weapons are expensive and maintenance-intensive enough that most commands reserve them for their best marksmen.
